title: Type 1 Diabetes KP webinar video available
summary: Our January 14, 2021 webinar featured an overview of type 1 diabetes biology and genetics, an update on functional characterization of T1D-associated loci, and a demonstration of the T1DKP.
bodyHtml: In our January 14, 2021 webinar, Dr. Suna Onengut-Gumuscu (University of Virginia) gave an overview of type 1 diabetes biology, progression, and genetics; Dr. Kyle Gaulton (University of California at San Diego) discussed functional characterization of T1D-associated loci, and Noël Burtt of the Knowledge Portal team (Broad Institute) demonstrated the T1DKP.
